title: 同欣電、シンガポールの寰邦科技を129%のプレミアムで買収へ 1株2.3シンガポールドルで非公開化推進

status.text: Agreed: Tong Hsing's board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to acquire all of SGX-listed GTC at S$2.30/share, a ~129% premium; deal awaits shareholder and regulatory approvals.
status.text_ja: 同欣電はGTC(シンガポール上場)の全株式買収をスキームで承認。価格は1株2.30シンガポールドル、溢価は約129%。各当局の承認待ち。

since.headline: Tong Hsing board approves Scheme of Arrangement to buy all of GTC at S$2.30/share, ~129% premium, deal worth about S$76.7m
since.summary: Tong Hsing Electronic Industries' (6271.TW) board resolved to acquire 100% of Singapore-listed Global Testing Corporation (GTC, also referred to as 環邦科技/寰邦科技) via a Scheme of Arrangement and delist it, at S$2.30 per share, a roughly 129.31% premium to GTC's one-month volume-weighted average price before trading was halted; the deal covers 33,351,527 shares for a total of about S$76.71 million (about NT$1.967 billion), and requires approval from GTC shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting plus Taiwan's Investment Commission, the Singapore Exchange and a Singapore court.
since.summary_ja: 同欣電子(6271)の取締役会は、シンガポール上場のGTC(環邦科技/寰邦科技)全株式をスキーム・オブ・アレンジメント方式で取得し非公開化する方針を決議した。価格は1株2.30シンガポールドルで、取引停止前1カ月間の出来高加重平均価格に対し約129.31%の溢価。対象株式は3335万1527株、総額は約7671万シンガポールドル(約新台幣19.67億元)。GTC株主の臨時株主総会に加え、台湾の経済部投資審議司、シンガポール取引所、シンガポールの裁判所の承認が必要となる。
